set.body: Consumer PLS Neuro requires MNI-space fixtures. Nifti.writeVol/writeVec hard-code sform code1 even for explicitly normalized affine geometry. Add typed output coordinate-system option preserving default behavior; do not infer registration from geometry. Write spatial units consistently. Verify JVM raw header bytes, roundtrip affine/data and unchanged default; run image JVM and JS suites. Consumer issue plsneuro bd-01M1VHC797QWB5ND4HSF7VRZ4G. No app-specific writer branches.
set.title: Allow explicit NIfTI output coordinate-system declaration
